Kuvitus: lasinen kasvihuone lumisena tal: Illustration: a glass greenhouse on a snowy winter night. There are stars in the dark sky and spruce forest in the background. Under the roof of the greenhouse are rows of red and blue LED lamps whose light fills the greenhouse with a pink glow. Inside, rows of tomato plants with red tomatoes are growing. The light is reflected on the snow in front of the greenhouse.
Käsitekartta. Ylhäällä solmu kvantittunu: Concept map. At the top is the node quantised energy: the photon energy E = h f and the link between mass and energy E = m c squared. Three branches lead down from it. The photon and the atom, the world of electronvolts: the photoelectric equation h f = W + E k max, the photon of a spectral line h f = E y minus E a and the threshold voltage of an LED e U k approximately h f. The nucleus, the world of megaelectronvolts: the decay law N = N 0 times one half to the power t over T half, the activity A = lambda N and the reaction energy Q = the mass difference times c squared. Radiation and people, dose: the absorbed dose D = E over m, the equivalent dose H T = w R times D T and the inverse square law of distance. At the bottom, a rule joining all the branches: first one particle, then the number.
joka haarassa: yksi hiukkanen, sitten lu: in every branch: one particle, then the number
Kaavakuva, energia-akseli logaritmisessa: Diagram, an energy axis on a logarithmic scale: the photon energy in electronvolts from a tenth to ten million, each division ten times the previous one. Visible light is a narrow coloured band 1.7–3.3 electronvolts, and the photon of red LED light is 1.9 electronvolts. A dashed line at 12.6 electronvolts is the ionisation energy of a water molecule: to its left a photon does not ionise water, to its right it does. The photon of a dental X-ray, about 60 kiloelectronvolts, and the gamma photon of caesium-137, 662 kiloelectronvolts, are far to the right. Brackets below the axis: the differences between the energy levels of the electrons of an atom are of the order of electronvolts, those of the nucleus of kilo- and megaelectronvolts.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: jäljellä oleva os: Graph to scale: the remaining fraction as a function of the number n of half-lives or half-value thicknesses, n from zero to five. The curve starts at 1 and falls ever more gently. Dashed lines show that n = 1 gives a half, n = 2 a quarter and n = 3 an eighth. The curve approaches zero but does not reach it: decay and the attenuation of gamma radiation have no end point.
Kuvaaja: pysäytysjännite U voltteina val: Graph: the stopping voltage U in volts as a function of the frequency f of the light, the unit of the frequency axis 10 to the power 14 hertz. The horizontal axis starts at 5.0 and ends at 8.5, the vertical axis from zero to 1.4 volts. Five black points at frequencies 5.94–8.21 and voltages 0.21–1.15 volts rise steadily and lie roughly on the same straight line.

Graph: the stopping voltage U in volts as a function of the frequency f of the light, the frequency axis from zero to 9 times 10 to the power 14 hertz and the voltage axis from minus 2.5 to plus 1.5 volts. A rising straight line has been fitted to five points and extended as a dashed line to the vertical axis. The line crosses the vertical axis at about minus 2.24 volts and the horizontal axis at about 5.43 times 10 to the power 14 hertz. The points used for reading are circled on the line: zero and minus 2.24 volts, and 8.0 times 10 to the power 14 hertz and 1.06 volts.
